components.name: Live Diagram
components.description: A featured pop-up's mini demo, animated from the repo's code: the project's layers as stops on a line, with a Signal Blue pulse easing between them. uptime-monitor shows its planned pipeline (API, PostgreSQL, Scheduler, Queue, Worker, Checker, Alerts) with unbuilt stages dashed: a monitor is created (201), then two sample checks reach the checker, one up and one timing out on to Alerts; DSA shows its bubble and selection sorts as bars; Int wrapper steps through main.cpp's operators and frees its heap Ints one recursive ptr_deleter call at a time; Hand Gesture eases between the recorded mean poses with a reading at each stop. Stops run down on phones, across from 40rem. It plays once on open with the replay's Pause/Play/Replay control and is still under reduced motion.

components.name: Dot Field
components.description: A liquid field of grey (Ink) dashes on a fixed canvas across the whole page, Antigravity-style. Poisson-disc particles (26px), faded to a faint 14% under the text column and within 16px of it, brightening over 110px. A ring (30% of the larger screen side) trails the mouse with a 0.45s ease and circles a resting mouse; with no mouse it wanders widely. It breathes and is noise-edged. Particles on its band swell into dashes that point away from the centre; inside are medium dashes and outside are specks. Sizes ease over 0.22s, and gradient noise keeps everything drifting. Mouse only; one still frame under reduced motion. Decorative and aria-hidden.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 10rem; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--color-ink); }

components.name: Particles Switch
components.description: A pill pinned to the bottom-right corner in the navbar's translucent Paper: "Particles" in Graphite Sans 500 at 0.75rem and a small switch whose track is Signal Blue with the knob right while the background particles are on, and Hairline Strong with the knob left while off. A role=switch button; the choice is remembered on the device.
components.css: .ds-ptoggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.4375rem 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-paper) 78%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -14px rgb(23 23 23 / 0.22); font: 500 0.75rem var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-ptrack { position: relative; width: 1.75rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-line-strong); } .ds-ptrack::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0.125rem; left: 0.125rem; width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-paper); } .ds-ptoggle[aria-checked="true"] .ds-ptrack { background: var(--color-blue); } .ds-ptoggle[aria-checked="true"] .ds-ptrack::after { transform: translateX(0.75rem); }

narrative.overview:
One narrow column on a cool near-white with a faint blue cast, about 640px, read top to bottom like a well-made personal page. It runs name, role line and short bio, a facts card (studying, open to, local time), four project rows, experience, a Technologies section that opens with a sliding strip of logos and then lists every technology, the longest contribution streak, six more repos with a link to the rest on GitHub, and how to reach them. Instrument Serif at 400 carries the voice moments: the 40px name, project names and dialog titles. Instrument Sans carries everything else at small, even sizes. JetBrains Mono appears only where the content is literally code or a file name.

The owner's standing steer governs every surface: "not too bold, professionalism with taste". The page stays a summary. Each featured project is a hairline row with a serif name, its year and an arrow, one short line and tags. The row opens a native dialog keyed to the URL hash, and the full story lives there. That story is the overview, a live diagram of the project working, gesture data or a code listing, a Details list and the source link. Whitespace groups the page. Hairlines appear only in lists: Projects, More projects, Contact, the dialog's Details, the dialog foot and the footer.

Under the bio, a facts card answers what someone hiring checks first and the page doesn't say elsewhere: where they study, what they're open to, and their local time.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-white page with a faint blue cast, near-black ink, two quieter greys, blue-gray hairlines.
Visuals sit in soft Panel fills with a 14px radius. The dialog is the one Paper surface lifted off the page.
Serif for names and titles, sans for everything else, mono only for literal code and markings.
Links are ink with a light blue-gray underline that darkens on hover. Blue is not a link colour.
Blue, the only accent, marks focus, the active pin, the gesture skeletons and one status word.
One shadow in the system, on the open dialog.
Motion is a 160ms colour change, plus a 200ms dialog rise and a pausable 45s tech strip. Both of those stop under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Slate On Paper Rule
rules.body: Slate (`ink-3`) sits on Paper only. It clears AA on Paper (4.97:1) but only just clears it on Panel (4.57:1). Text inside a panel uses Graphite (5.19:1 on Panel) or Ink, and a list row's Slate icon, arrow or year turns Ink or gives way when the row tints on hover.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only accent. It marks focus, the active pin, the gesture bones and the "In development" status word (5.67:1 on Paper, 5.22:1 on Panel). It is never decoration, a heading colour, a link colour or a fill.

rules.name: The Serif Names Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif sets names only: the person, a project name and a dialog title. It is always weight 400, and only the serif goes above 1rem. Sans text stays between 0.75rem and 1rem, and its emphasis comes from weight (500 for links, labels and list names) and from moving between Ink, Graphite and Slate.

rules.name: The Literal Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for text that is literally code, a file name or a gesture name. It is always weight 400 and never used for prose, labels or headings.

rules.name: The Space Groups Rule
rules.body: Group with whitespace and the panel fill. Hairlines are for lists only: the intro facts, the Projects, More projects and Contact rows, the Details facts, the rule above the dialog foot and the footer. Never put dividers between sections.

rules.name: The Summary And Story Rule
rules.body: The page carries a summary of each project. The full story (media, overview, live diagram, figures, facts and source) lives in that project's dialog, reachable by URL hash.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: The modal dialog is the only element with a shadow and a backdrop. Rows, panels and buttons stay flat. Hover changes tone, never elevation.

dos: Do present each featured project as a hairline row (serif name, year and arrow, one short line, tags) that opens its full story in a hash-keyed dialog.
Do keep the open dialog the only lifted surface: Paper, 18px radius, one soft shadow, 40% ink backdrop, a bottom sheet below 40rem.
Do make links Ink with a Hairline Strong underline that darkens on hover over 160ms.
Do separate sections with space (5rem to 6.5rem between sections), and keep hairlines for lists.
Do set names in Instrument Serif 400, code and file names in JetBrains Mono 400, and everything else in Instrument Sans.
Do keep Slate text on Paper and use Graphite or Ink inside panels.
Do keep motion to 160ms colour changes, the 200ms dialog rise and the pausable tech strip, and turn the rise and the strip off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't add a header bar, navigation, numbered sections or tables.
Don't box tags or turn them into pills; tags are plain text joined by middle dots. The dialog's Close button is the only pill.
Don't use blue for links or decoration, or add a second accent colour.
Don't put a shadow on anything but the open dialog, and don't lift anything on hover.
Don't add a dark mode; the system is light only by design.
Don't put a label, kicker or eyebrow above the name, a section title, a project name or a dialog title.
Don't set sans text larger than 1rem or use the serif for anything but names.
Don't add page-load or scroll-triggered entrance animations, or autoplaying media.
